scope: Concrete config-core, native current-build evidence, account-scoped installer and transactional backup/rollback. Read-only installed inspection; fixture tests only.

nativeEvidence.authoritativeVideoBaseline: FSR2 with approximately 0.8 scale, texture mip bias 2, all BASE quality values already reduced.
nativeEvidence.aggressiveDelta: FSR2 to FSR1 at equal 0.8 scale; FSR1 sharpening 0 to 0.2; remove 31 unique nonmenu manual keys / 32 occurrences; archive gameplay cap 400 to 0.

findings.title: Nested Steam AppState originally prevented all installer modes
findings.repair: allowNested shallow scalar reading is explicitly enabled for AppState only.
findings.evidence: Independent reproduction before repair; actual-machine read-only verify succeeded after repair; nested-manifest fixture passed.

findings.title: Rollback originally wrote despite game-start guard failure
findings.repair: Game/context guard is checked before rollback writes.
findings.evidence: Game-start-after-first-write fixture passed; second file unchanged, rollback withheld and originals retained.

findings.title: Rollback originally lacked a pre-write backup hash check
findings.repair: Backup beforeHash is checked before replacing target.
findings.evidence: Tampered-backup fixture passed; damaged bytes were not written.

findings.title: Restore originally depended on current candidate resolution
findings.repair: forRestore context and guard omit the 1920x1080 apply restriction.
findings.remainingScope: Restore retains audited hardware/device/schema/build guards; no promise of automatic future-patch recovery.

limitations: No gameplay benchmark was performed. The native baseline was already ultra reduced.
Removing hidden/manual overrides can restore rendering work; it is compatibility/readability normalization, not a quantified FPS win.
Two files are individually replaced with verified backups; this is not a power-loss atomic multi-file transaction or a guarantee against every external writer race.
Menu/default evidence establishes legitimate native controls. Stored values cannot establish actual runtime acceptance, image clarity or best performance.
